card.name: Drug label warning and interaction headings
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a warning or interaction heading, such as 'Laboratory' before 'Tests', 'with' after 'associated', or the middle of 'digoxin' and 'uterine'. Appears in drug-label warnings and interactions sections.

modes.label: Laboratory test interference
modes.description: The word Laboratory or Test in headings about interference with lab tests.
modes.example: 5.19 Interference with<< Laboratory>> Tests for Opioid Detection LYBAL

modes.label: Inside digoxin
modes.description: The middle or end of the word digoxin in drug interaction text.
modes.example: Monitor plasma digox<<in>> levels in patients treated concomitantly

modes.label: Fluoroquinolone reaction phrase
modes.description: Linking words in 'serious adverse reactions associated with fluoroquinolones'.
modes.example: avoid the use of fluoroquinolones, including CIPRO, in patients who have experienced any of these serious<< adverse>> reactions associated with fluoroquinolones

card.plain: It fires on a word in the middle of a warning phrase or drug name, where the next word is mostly predictable.
